items.text: Hello, Crewmates!

[p align="start"]As of today, we will no longer be supporting any 2024 versions of Among Us. If you see “v2024” on the bottom left of the main menu, you will be affected. Please update your game to v17.4.0 as soon as possible so you can keep making MIRA HQ proud by doing tasks!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33836086/c818ff726a8e04593fca75a339be3c34ce6052c6.png"]
[p align="start"]Among Us is still expanding with features, roles, bug updates, improved security, etc. and getting Crewmates on similar versions helps with that development.
[p align="start"]Thanks for understanding and sticking with us no matter which version you’ve been playing on.
[p align="start"]Innersloth
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33836086/6a95c769a50b36d74e320edc8f8d551df754a73a.png"]
Hi Crewmates,
[p align="start"]Teeny tiny update v17.1.0 is now out.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Curious about what it contains?
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Alright.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Are you ready? Hold your breath. Prepare your reading eyes. This could drive you insane from the sheer amount of words this will hold:

NEW: Stardew Valley Cosmicube will be available until Feb 18, 2026 at 17:00 UTC. And the best part? It’s FREE – for only 3300 Beans, this bountiful harvest can be yours. Get it before it withers away.
NEW: Create Game screen. As requested by you, the backgrounds have been updated to reflect the map chosen!
[img src="https://www.innersloth.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/v1710-horizontal-1024x576.png"]
……. Ummm.
Yep that’s actually it.

[p align="start"]I know. You’re mindblown. But check out the Cosmicube and hope to see you in those lobbies!….You know, any normal player would want the November dev log to end here since there’s really nothing else to say, but I know you. You’re sick. You’re twisted. The other Crewmates will never understand the depths of your darkness. I’ve seen what you’ve done. The lies you’ve told during Emergency Meetings so that you could get away with murder. The unravelling of your core values as you realized how easy it is to manipulate your best friends. They thought you were sweet. Docile. Innocent, even. Then you showed them. You showed the WORLD what you could do when given the opportunity to sabotage the lights. I’m disgusted by you. But also… in awe. Here I am, sitting in the safety of Admin, while you’re out there making a name for yourself. I respect you. I fear you. I hope to never walk along the same path as you because I know that if we were to lock visors, I would be dead.
[p align="start"]Okay bye!
[p align="start"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33836086/3c7bb7a20f092646c8193e0fa669c30d1a1d7b11.png"]
[p align="start"]Victoria
Hiya, Crewmates!

\[Friends List] Fixed issue with sending and receiving friend requests.
\[How to Play] \ Fixed issue where the selected role in the menu would not stay highlighted.
\[How to Play] Fixed issue where scroll bar would display past screen boundaries at some resolutions.
\[How to Play] Fixed issue where scroll bar hitbox was misaligned.
\ Updated the role reveal SFX.
\ Fixed issue where the role reveal hint doesn’t fit on screen in certain languages.
\ Fixed issue where selection menus in the Notes could not be closed without selecting an option.
\ Updated the role reveal SFX.
\ \ Fixed issue where role reveal hint doesn’t fit on screen properly.
\ \ Fixed issue where role reveal hint doesn’t fit on screen properly.
\ \[Latin American Spanish] Fixed issue where role reveal hint doesn’t fit on screen properly.
\PC: \ Fixed issue where Interrogate ability could be used while the settings menu is open.
\PC: \ \ Fixed issue where the closing animation did not play when closing the Notes window.
\PC: \ \ Fixed issue where the map locations would appear and remain on screen if the Notes ability was activated at the same time.
\PC: \ \ Fixed issue where opening the map with two different inputs could cause other inputs to stop working.
\PC: \ \ \ Fixed issue where the Notes window can be opened underneath the Settings window.

\[The Fungle] \ Fixed issue where “Dock” was missing from the locations on the map.
[p align="start"]

[p align="start"]We've also been hard at work trying to solve the duplicate login issues and are tackling the hacking reports from this weekend (Oct 11-14, 2025). If you’re running into this problem or any new ones, send us your player log if you’re on PC when you send us a helpdesk ticket.
[p align="start"]And now that you’re done reading…
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]FIND ME THAT VIPER!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Dors

Hello, Crewmates!

As of today, we will no longer be supporting any 2023 versions of Among Us. If you see “v2023” on the bottom left of the main menu, you will be affected. Please update your game to 16.1.0 as soon as possible so you can keep betraying your friends playing!

We plan to keep expanding Among Us with features, roles, bug updates, improved security, etc. and getting Crewmates on similar versions helps with that development.
Thanks for understanding and sticking with us no matter which version you’ve been playing on.
Innersloth
Hiya, Crewmates!
Make sure you're on version 16.0.5 so you're good to go! Let's take a look at what it covers.

If everything goes according to plan (fingers crossed for no sabotages), you won't notice any big changes. This is because the update focused on changes to the backend, which helps us keep development moving forward. This includes improvements for how we tackle hacks, exploits, and bugs.

notes.title: Here are some of the changes you can see in this update

items.text: [The Fungle] - Impostors and Shapeshifters can't kill through sabotaged doors anymore (you're safe for now, Crewmates!)
Hack fixes - We deployed anti-hacks and are keeping our visors peeled for any new sabotages. Big thank you to everyone who reported the issues, and to the hard work of the programming team.
Updates to the Kamurocho Cosmicube - We updated some Kamurocho cosmetic names along with a minor store image change (can you spot the difference?)
If you come across any new issues, remember to send us a helpdesk ticket!
Welcome to the part of the devlog where we talk about the bugs and glitches that have creepily crawled into the game. Here's what you may run into while you're prepping your alibi:
Switching from windowed to fullscreen may break the UI.
In rare cases, accepting a game invite will cause a disconnect with the Among Us servers.
It is difficult to see currently highlighted buttons on the Find Game screen while using a controller.
Exiting Practice Mode returns players to the Main Menu instead of the Online Menu.
In rare instances, buttons can't be selected while in the Dropship.
Players may remain on the Find Game screen when trying to join a lobby after a network disconnect.
[Hide n Seek] - Win stats are not updating as intended.

The team is working hard to eject these bugs, so hang tight! If you encounter any bugs or glitches, send us a ticket via our helpdesk! Remember to be as descriptive as possible so we can hone in on a solution and get you back to your tasks.
Before you enter the Dropship, let's take a moment to talk about one of the more recent bugs that's had an impact on Among Us.

When we released 16.0.0, we saw more black screen errors reported by players when trying to start a round. This would crash the game and give out an incorrect temporary ban (like in the screenshot above), which made for an understandably frustrating experience.

notes.title: Let's break down how the temporary bans work

items.text: Temp bans exist to discourage players from disrupting the game flow. This can be for things like: repeatedly leaving games before they're over, or leaving right after role reveals because you didn't get the Impostor role.
Leaving one game before it's over shouldn't result in an immediate temp ban.
Leaving multiple games before they conclude will start to count against you and potentially get you a temp ban.
Before the 16.0.0 update, you could completely close Among Us, and that would clear a temp ban. Now, this isn't possible.
With the last hotfix (16.0.2), we tweaked how you could get a temp ban. Now, if you disconnect from the game before roles are revealed, that won't count against you.
Now, you should see far fewer instances of getting a false temp ban (AKA super long timeout) because of a black screen or game crash.
That was a lot of info! Hopefully, this helps clarify what's been happening. Before we go, let's dive into the Fun Zone!
One of my favorite parts about writing these blog posts is sharing the creations y'all come up with. Without further ado, let's start off with some art from our official Discord.
This piece is rad looking bean is by Zel! Gotta say, those Kamurocho cosmetics go pretty hard. I wouldn't mess with Lime.
This next piece also comes from the art section of our Discord. Honestly, SMHtheConeDodger captured how I act during Emergency Meetings, haha... don't look into it.

This next piece is from DarkD33z over on the subreddit! I love how Red is looming in the background like the villian on a movie poster. The shimmering effect across the colors is really slick too. Great job!!

You Crewmates are so talented! Keep up the great work, cause we never get tired of seeing what you're making. Remember to tag us on Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, and TikTok when you're sharing so we can get our visors on what you make.
Dors
fix is out, Impostors ejected!
we rolled out a new wave of anti-hacks so ur game should be back to expected levels of chaos.
thanks for ur patience 🙏 it's never fun dealing with hackers, and we'll continue doing our best to be sabotage free. ur support means everything!
We’re rolling out fixes for the black screen -> app crash -> long timeout issue.
Update to 16.0.2 to resolve the sabotage!
If you’re still experiencing this issue AFTER the update, please let us know via our helpdesk (with a player log if possible!)
Dors
Matchmaker, find me a match!
Update 16.0.0 is here and brings an important change to Among Us! Remember to update your game so you get these changes and can keep betraying everyone.

HERE. WE. GO. Our overhauled matchmaking is here! The team made changes thanks to your responses to last year's player feedback survey. Your thoughts have had a big influence on the kind of chaos we bring in updates like this. Thanks for helping shape Among Us.
At the core of matchmaking, we want to make sure you have the right tools to find the lobby you want. With that in mind, our team put their heads together and cooked up this new interface:

Doesn't that look snazzy? The screen delivers key info at a glance like: the amount of lobbies currently online in your server region, the map, and how many Crewmates there are. We added the player speed and if roles are activated too. With all these visible right away, you can quickly choose a lobby if you're trying to jump into a round.
We've heard your cries for improved filtering! Now you can fine tune your searches via the "Filters" button. When you do, you'll see this new screen:
In the "Filters" screen you can choose the settings you'd like to home in on for your preferred lobby. Choices include:
Classic
Hide n Seek
Maps
Number of Impostors
Roles
Player Speed
Kill cooldown
Voting time
Visual tasks
Anonymous votes
Confirm ejects
Tags (Beginner, Intermediate, Expert)

After you select your settings and close the tab, you'll see how many lobbies match your choices and be able to join. If you can't find any games with the settings you chose, either unselect some or choose the "clear filters" option to wipe all the filters at once and start over! This just means you've gotten too specific.
When you find a lobby you're ready to join, you can either tap the listing to dive right in or click "More" and see the game details:
If the lobby settings look good to you, it's time to join and investigate some Impostors (or at least carry your fellow Crewmates).

For those Crewmates who like holding the reins and creating lobbies - your experience has been upgraded too. After you select Play and Online you'll see 3 options: Create Game, Enter Code, and Find Game. When you choose Create Game you'll see this:
Along with the cute animation every time you increase the player capacity, you'll be able to choose between:
Classic and Hide n Seek modes
The 5 maps
Tags
Server regions
Chat types
Chat language
When you select "Create Game" you'll see a confirmation screen before it's set in stone and unchangeable forever... bwahahahahahaha (not really - you can always change these).

"But what about the roles and visual tasks and confirming votes...?" You'll still be able to edit these settings once you're in the Dropship by going to the good ol' laptop and editing the settings from the menu we updated previously:
Among Us is best when playing with your friends (and soon to be enemies). When one of them sends you a lobby code to join a match you'll have an updated screen as well:

Now, when you enter a code you'll be able to confirm the host, lobby capacity, region, and the chat type. If all looks in order, you can click "Join Game" and enter the lobby. And don't worry if your chat type or region don't match - the game will update this for you (as long as you have permissions to use Free Chat) so you can focus on the upcoming chaos!

Wooooo - that was a lot of info. If you find it a bit confusing, check out our handy tutorial. We hope these changes make it WAY easier for you to find that perfect lobby and be the impressive Impostors you really are.
As you start getting used to the new setup, we'd love your feedback as well as any reports on bugs that may have skittered in with this update. You can send those to us at our helpdesk!

It's time to be(an) like a dragon, Crewmates! Our first Cosmicube collab of the year is here. Spend 110 Stars so you can start unlocking some criminally good cosmetics - check our collab blog for the details.
With these hot new cosmetics you'll be ready for The Skeld karaoke party or to chase after all those Crewmates dressed like Kiryu-chan...
Before you head to the cafeteria, let's cover one more change for this update.
Those of you with sharp visors will note that I called this update 16.0.0 instead of v2025.3.25. That's because of Impostor sabotage the team wanted to make things easier for us going forward.
What do the new numbers mean? Well, if we reference the image above:
The first number (blue box) increases whenever we have major updates. Think updated systems like matchmaking, or content like new maps or roles!
The second number (red box) increases when we have smaller updates. This includes things like bug fixes or cosmetic drops.
The third number in the series (yellow box) will increase if we deploy hotfixes or have platform specific changes.
This new version system will also help us narrow down what could be causing you trouble if you have to send us a helpdesk ticket.
Speaking of the helpdesk - let's check in with Mike in the Bug Zone!

So many things to explore! Our team has worked hard on our tasks to get the new matchmaking feature ready, and we hope you love all the new ways to find exactly the lobbies you want. But like any new feature, there's always the chance that some things don't work exactly like we planned.

Don't worry, we're keeping a lookout! If you see anything that doesn't work, are having trouble finding games with your friends, or see anything else that might be a new bug crawling out from under the Dropship, let us know. Crewmates like yourselves play a big role in helping us find and squash bugs, ya know!

If you find something wrong, head over to this page and send us a message. Remember - specific is better! Tell us everything you can, send screenshots, record a video if you can get the issue to happen more than once, etc. Our team will look over everything and figure out if there's something to fix.
Phew. Okay, enough bug talk. Time to create the perfect lobby to sabotage diligently complete my tasks...
Mike
If you made it here, you have one final task... check out some fun community creations!
First up is from one redditor, Ok_Walk_9285! They drew some adorable little Crewmates and did it all through MS Paint?! Great color choices and cute style, imo.
Our second piece of community art is also from the subreddits! This cool automata was made by backwardslamb. Major kudos on bringing Red out of the vent... literally!
This third creation was drawn by Felix from our official Discord server! They took a "bean of the week" prompt and personified it. I think you should add a gold star, Felix! You earned it.

We never get tired of seeing the wonderful art and creations y'all make! Be sure to tag us on Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky and Tiktok when you're sharing so we can get our visors on what you make.
Off to the karaoke lounge,
Dors
It's time for our BIGGGG bug update, Crewmates!

Our programmers have been hard at work yeeting bugs that have been creepy crawling their way into the game. Some of them you wouldn't have seen but trust us - they're gone now. If you see any bugs disrupting your perfect Impostor plans send us a ticket!
Make sure your game is updated to v2024.10.29 for the fixes.
Don't worry about Yellow... they're fine. They just helped fix the following:
Trying to start an Online lobby while permanently or temporarily banned will no longer put the game into an endless black screen. Remember to play nice.
Updated the Tracker's ability to display as "TRACK" instead of "TRACKER".
The "Room Code Copied" text will now disappear after you copy the room code.
Fixed the misaligned cursors in the chat, 'Edit Name', and 'Add Friend' windows.
Corrected visuals for viewing the Store and Wardrobe while playing at 3440x1440 resolution.
- We lowered the volume of The Skeld song in the lobby. Sorry it was too loud! You can adjust the volume further with the volume slider in the settings.
- The friends list icon no longer moves when accepting a game invite.
- Chat bubbles shouldn't break through the chat window when scrolling.
- The visor and hat on the host icon are now layered correctly.
- Hats now layer correctly when stacking with other players on the Dropship.
- Fixed layering issues for chat in multiple windows.
- Fixed inconsistent fonts being displayed for special characters.
- Game setting updates now display with the correct icons and colors when popping up on the left side of the screen.
- The plus and minus buttons in the role settings will continue to work after you select a game preset.
- The plus and minus buttons in the role settings no longer stay highlighted after selecting them.
- Button click SFX no longer occur when you click the map icon during the start of a game.
- The practice dummies will now respawn after calling an Emergency Meeting.
[Airship / Fungle] - Visors are layered correctly during ladder animations.
[Skeld / Polus] - We removed a controller button icon that appeared during the Inspect Samples task even if you weren't using a controller.
- Crewmates don't get frozen in the climbing animation if a Mushroom Mixup is called while on the ladder.
Okay - deep breath! Thanks for your patience as we got through all these fixes. We're always on the look out for glitches and bugs that are disruptive. If you see any, remember to submit a ticket!

This update is a great time to let you know that the our backend team worked tirelessly to fix the slew of hacks in the last few months which have been impacting lobbies. Combating hacks is like resolving Sabotages - when you fix one another might appear later.

Just like when you see a bug, you can report a hack to us by submitting a ticket. Any info you can send is helpful in making sure we can keep Among Us free of disruptive behavior that takes the fun away (outside of Impostors of course).

Try to be descriptive, and if you can get pictures (or video), then that helps out even more! It's like an Emergency Meeting - anything you can add beyond "I saw a thing" gives the team a better shot at solving the mystery.
We've talked bugs. We've talked hacks. How about we wind down with some community fan art?
First up is a piece worthy of being evidence from Waffles! on X (Twitter)! The Miles Edgeworth drop brought a lot of excitement and seeing art like this made it even better. Literally no objections.
Up next is Nyan from our official Discord channel! They've done a very cute rendition of their robo-bean. I wonder what operating system it runs on.
Also from our Discord, we have Whisperjein with a lovely... Mermate? Crewmaid? It looks to be making quite a splash.
Over on Reddit, Wellgooey has been croucheting some wonderful Fungle pals! I wouldn't worry about being stranded on an island if I had these cute creations for company.

Thanks for sharing your beautiful beans with us Crewmates! Your art brings the team a lot of joy. Remember to tag us on Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky and Tiktok when you're sharing your creations.

And speaking of creations - not long ago we shared some cute (and scary) pumpkin carving templates so you can scare impress Crewmates during this spooky month. If you use the templates we'd love to see how they turned out! And if you have your own Crewmate designs tag us on our social channels above!
Ta ta for now,
Dors
Behold!
It's update time, Crewmates - v2024.8.13 brings new fixes and an exciting new Cosmicube to get your knife wielding hands on. Let's take a look!

Our newest collab with Critical Role is here with the most adventurous looks yet for your Crewmates and Impostors. Gilmore's Curious Cosmicube features fits from Vox Machina, The Mighty Nein, and Bells Hells - all for 110 Stars! Be sure to get yours before the collab is over on November 12, 2024 at 7 a.m. UTC (2 a.m. EST / Nov 11, 11 p.m. PST).
For all the details on the collab, check out these notes. And if you want advantage on your intelligence check, read up on how Cosmicubes work before your next adventure!
Read on to see what fixes we've lined up for the update.
Now it may seem like it's all fun and games (which is technically true) but we've been slaying some bugs and making fixes on the heels of our last update. Here's what's fixed:
- Phantoms will not be kicked or banned when their Vanish timer expires while using the floating platform repeatedly
[The Fungle] - Crewmates will not leave their hand behind when riding the zipline
[Mira HQ] - Players can no longer see other Crewmates overlapping the decontamination doors when Crewmate vision is set to 0.5x
[Classic / Fungle] - You can't report dead bodies through horizontal doors which have been sabotaged
- Choosing "Recommended Settings" switches Task Bar Updates to "Always" and Anonymous Votes to "Off"
- Switching roles while tracking a Dummy will not leave the Dummy tracked forever
[Guardian Angel] - Other players who are alive will no longer see the Guardian Angel briefly when a Crewmate dies and transitions to the role
[HnS Settings] - Scrolling will stop at the bottom of the available options for the custom settings
PC: - Scrolling will stop at the bottom of the visible options in the "All" tab of the Role Settings
PC: - You can no longer select different shop tabs while previewing items
The battery duration timer for the Scientist is no longer covered by the Settings icon
You can no longer start the game with fewer than 4 players
There is no longer a delay when toggling a lobby between Public and Private with a controller
Controls no longer malfunction when you quickly open chat while accessing a Cosmicube
The "Bundles" header in the store no longer overlaps the items when scrolling
Pressing ESC will now dismiss the ban message pop-up - remember to play nice!
Text will display fully when multiple players disconnect from a lobby at the same time
The Right Hand Man skin now layers correctly with hats during the kill animation
Amount of Bean currency will no longer display when switching to Offline mode
Corrected layering issue with error messages displaying when viewing announcements
Players no longer get stuck in an infinite loading screen under certain circumstances
Switching to the Cosmicubes tab in the shop with a controller no longer scrolls the list
Our programmers have been doing a lot of fixing! Remember to send us a support ticket if you see anything amiss. I'm gonna let Mike take his turn to cover the bug zone!
Off to lend a hand,
Dors

You know when you're close to winning a game and people start saying "Crewmates, do your tasks"? Well, our Crewmates listened! Just look at how many bugs and issues were fixed up there! We must be close to winning by tasks, right? Well, almost... there's still more stuff to work on. A Crewmate's job is never done!
Here's a quick look at some of the possible issues players may encounter after this update. If you find any more, make sure you send us a bug report so we can start working on it.
[The Fungle] - Players with certain screen aspect ratios may see buttons cut off during gameplay
[Practice Mode] - Dummies may not spawn correctly after an emergency meeting has been called
Players may see missing letters/characters on the lobby screen with certain language settings
Players with Child Accounts who become old enough to age into Adult Accounts may experience problems accessing certain age-related features
The Friendlist button may be placed incorrectly after accepting a lobby invitation
Still on a roll,
Mike

P.S. As always, we can't wait to see what you think of the collab and see what you fanart works you come up with! Remember to tag us on our socials at Twitter, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, Bluesky and TikTok!
We heard you, Crewmates!

It's February, Crewmates!
Errr... it was February and boy if it didn't go by in a flash. I hope it was a great month full of finished tasks and you were able to suss out those Impostors.
This month we have some sweet things to share for Among Us including some really cool new cosmetics, changes to our announcements, and various fixes as a part of your latest update - v2023.2.28!

Our first collab of the year begins with the Guardian Cosmicube, available on our store for 3500 Beans! This cube is packed full of cosmetics so you can chase Impostors, pet your pets, and complete your tasks as your favorite light-wielding Guardians from our friends at Bungie. Be sure to get your Guardian Cube by May 30, 2023 before it disappears!

Our announcements have a brand new look to them! Not only will it have that new Skeld smell, but you'll have the ability to see past announcements we've posted in case you want to see what happened in prior updates!

notes.title: This is what our announcements used to look like

items.text: While this has been working well - the team thought it could do with a little sprucing up. That's where our UI expert Lucy comes in! Thanks to their efforts we now have a page that looks a little something like this:
Doesn't this look great? I can't reveal too many secrets, but this is just the first of our passes for updated UI for Among Us! We'll have plenty more in store for some cool new looks.
And of course, we did some serious fixing in this patch to make sure your game runs smoother!:
'Freeplay' is now called 'Practice'
New updated player report and pet petting icons
Pets no longer give away an Engineer's position when venting
Guardian Angel can no longer protect Crewmates while comms are sabotaged
Shapeshifters no longer get banned from match when attempting to shift into player who has left the match
Shapeshifters are no longer considered Crewmate Ghosts in matches with 2 or more Impostors
The first ejected Impostor now becomes a Ghost Impostor, rather than a Ghost Crewmate
Crewmates are able to win a match by completing tasks even after the first Impostor is ejected in a 2+ Impostor match
Players are now unable to see players jumping out of vents and teleporting to the Cafeteria when Emergency Meeting is called
Polus - The upper and lower horizontal doors for decontamination can now be opened
Admin now shows location of dead bodies

That's a whole lot of fixes and we'll be squashing as many as possible as we keep updating and improving our other systems in Among Us. As a quick reminder - if you think you've found a bug feel free to report it to us at our Help Desk or email us at support@innersloth.com.
See you very soon,
Dors

I bet you didn't think I'd just keep writing and writing and end up down in the Bug Zone too, did you? Well... Good news is that Krys is helping me doublecheck our list of known bugs for v2023.2.28! Thankfully, the list of bugs isn't too long and we're hoping to have these squashed ASAP:
[Hide n Seek] Flashlight can't be moved while pet animation is in progress while using a controller
[Hide n Seek] Flashlight cone will reset its position if there is no player input after 8 seconds
Crewmates killed at the same time as venting will see the vent arrows persist while being a Ghost
[All Modes] Player Ghosts can shoot out of the map when attempting to haunt and immediately opening the Settings menu
Killing while petting your pet can cause the pet animation to keep playing
Vent arrows stay on screen if killed while venting
Players will see indefinite black screen if internet connection is lost while loading into an online game
That's all for bugs right now! We'll keep you updated as we knock more out with our next updates.
See you next round,
Dors & Krys

We got another solid round of community creations and art this month too! Check out our website for these lovely pieces. I can't wait to see what art you come up with next. Might I suggest some Savathûn and Osiris Impostor shenanigans? No matter what you do, just make sure you get to taking out those tasks one by one...
See you later,
Dors

Hi Crewmates!

No long preamble here – I have lots to share! Our team worked SO HARD and we managed to fix 100+ issues that were bothering you in Among Us. Here’s a big list of most of them, so make sure you’re update to version 2022.6.21, now out on all platforms.
First up: we’ve been listening to you! I know you’ve all wanted a lot of things improved in the game and I am happy to say we’ve changed some things to hopefully make your lives easier.
Quality of Life Improvements & Implemented Community Suggestions
Added a Streamer Mode. When active, room codes do not display in the lobby and is replaced by “Click to copy”. This can be toggled on or off in the General Settings.
Added Colorblind Settings. When active, the names of the colors will appear next to the players during meetings, and below the player during gameplay.
Account linking is back. Follow the in-game instructions carefully as we’ve removed Guest Accounts, but it should make it an easier process. More information on the new Account Linking here.
Players are now able to view the map from the voting screen.
Friends List – The player’s last display name will appear above a player’s Friend Code.
We definitely have wayyyy more planned in future, so keep playing the game and letting us know how you feel (nicely, pleaseeee) and I promise we’ll be listening.
But I’m not done this post yet – now for the some of the many fixes which made it into the game.
Loading screen now waits for every player in the lobby when loading into a round
Kills can no longer happen when an Emergency Meeting is being called
Players in game should no longer randomly lose the ability to interact with map, complete tasks, or kills
Quick Chat wheel can be used as intended while a task (Download Data / Upload Data) is being completed. Players will no longer be forced to close and re-open chat
Smooth Talker achievement can now be unlocked if the second to last Crewmate leaves the game
Players should no longer see the ‘Sure is taking a while’ error message when launching Among Us
Friend Codes no longer duplicate across all players when player and host rejoin lobby
Resolved desync issue when player reports body while climbing ladder
Redeem pop up message for Scream cosmetics no longer prompts. Redemption period for this cosmetic has passed!
Players will no longer see ‘Sure is taking a while’ if game is set to languages other than English
Players are now able to unlock the Circumventor achievement
Entering the correct date of birth no longer registers the account as age 0
Added the Language server filter to the settings in the Lobby
These are just a few of the fixes. For the entire list of fixes check out our dev log.

Thanks for being understanding about how we needed to take this time to really improve the game. Your feedback means a ton to us, and we all wanted to make sure we could start really chipping away at things that bothered you, even if it meant having to put a pause on some new content. That being said, new content is still on the horizon, so watch out!
June 15 was a special day for Amongis… AmongUses… AmongUs-s-sses? Now matter the plural form- Among Us has turned 4!
As part of our celebration we have brand new merch. We have the full suite of Crewmate colors, keycaps, and a bunch of new pins too. Grab yours at our store quick.
Okay now I’m actually done. Now to the rest of the dev log, onto you Krys!
Cheers,
Victoria

Hey Crewmates!
Alright so I definitely missed doing an April dev log completely. Shh. Don’t tell anyone. I was busy cleaning out the vents.
Before we look at the updates, wanted to let you all know that the Scream cosmetic redemption period is now over! Thanks to everyone who participated!

This one is a shorter dev log as we prepare for our big bug crunch and quality of life update. As I mentioned in the previous post, this next update isn’t about new content, but on making sure Among Us is given the time and care it needs to function smoothly.

We’ve been trying to meet everyone’s demands and add new content constantly. This meant other things have slipped through the cracks so the next update will be all about fixes – big kudos to our producer Kristi for making it all come together.
I’ve said it before and I’ll say it again - thank you so much for sticking with us! We appreciate the patience and encouragement!

So far, we have 72(!!!) confirmed bug fixes, we’ll be adding some changes to accounts, and over 30 more things are currently being tested to see if they’ll make it into the update. Confirmed fixes and improvements include things like:
Fixing 'Sure is taking a while' Offline error message when launching the game
Cosmetic layering issues
Rework of the age submission process
Added the ability to view the map from the voting screen (no more forgetting where you were, hooray!)
Friends List improvements
Of course, there’s much more than that, but I’ll give you a full list once the update is out!
There are other fun things happening too, but like always I am sworn to secrecy and must keep it stuffed in a vent until the time comes.

Also – we have a new community manager on board! You’ll see Dors writing these dev logs at some point, so make sure you’re nice and friendly and not murder-y when you see him come around. But for now – let's go to Krys for the all- important Bug Zone updates.
Cheers,
Victoria
Greetings and happy spring (or fall, or whatever your earthly time zone deems true), Crewmates! It’s a short Bugdate (get it? Bug Update? No? OK) this dev log, so let’s get right to it:

Everyone who submitted a request to Support to have their DLC regranted (and provided proof of purchase) should now have their stuff! If you don’t, please email logs@innersloth.com with a screenshot of your Account ID and your proof of purchase and we’ll take care of that for you ASAP.

Since Friends List rolled out, we are aware that some of you have had issues verifying your age so that you can use this feature. It’s important to note that we don’t have a choice when it comes to the age verification requirement – the ~*government*~ needs to make sure that we’re keeping our younger players safe and that they have their parent/guardian’s permission to play! We really appreciate your patience and understanding when it comes to age verification. If you have any issues with SuperAwesome’s age verification process, feel free to email us at support@innersloth.com. You can read more about SuperAwesome and our Privacy Policy here too.
That’s it for now. Thanks everyone!!

Hi Crewmates!
Quick post to let you know about the changes in the latest patch for version 2021.6.30.

Added vent cleaning task. Cleaning the vent will prevent any impostors from using that specific vent, but Impostors can still use other vents and the vent will be usable once it’s cleaned. If an Impostor is already camping out in a vent and then you start cleaning that vent, it'll boot them out with a dramatic sound and you'll see who it is. Surprise!
New languages. Traditional and Simplified Chinese and Irish localization added.
Getting stuck in place after a meeting is fixed. This was the biggest issue with the latest update, so run free now!! Be free beans!!

Scaling on "SHH" screen fixed. YES I read your comments on the SHH screen. The absolute hate that poor screen got, my goodness. I had to give it 3 tubs of ice cream to feel better. It's okay though, the world is aligned once again, the proportions have been fixed after it got weirdly borked.
Geoff eyepatch is now (sadly) back to being a mask. :(
Clouds in the Airship no longer move in the wrong direction. No more backwards progress! Onward!
Upload Data phone colors fixed. I have no clever caption for this.
All major buttons are now localized. Yeah I’m really running out of fun ways to make this content interesting.
Other minor visual and localization bug fixes. Our programming and QA team did a really great job please give them a psychic high five.
Wizard hat still missing. Still casting an invisibility spell. Working on finding it, sorry!
4:3 resolution still needs to be scaled. That’ll be addressed.
And quite a few others, but those are the biggest ones I'll list out.

And if you're a fan of grabbing physical editions of the game on console, pre-orders for it has just opened up!! (Release date for the game on Xbox and PlayStation has NOT been announced yet.) It comes with a ton of goodies with 3 different editions - Ejected, Crewmate, and Impostor! Check them out and pre-order here​.

That’s it for now! Don’t forget the roadmap is the place to go if you’re interested in what we’re working on next, and check out our updated mod and fan creation policy if that’s something you were curious about.
See you next time!
Victoria
